title: DHS Proposes New OPT Fee as International Students Face New Restrictions
summary_en: Colleges and universities would have to pay $70,000 for each international student they recommend for Optional Practical Training (OPT) under a Trump administration proposal announced Oct. 7.
title_cn: DHS Proposes New OPT Fee as International Students Face New Restrictions

title: Last Chance to Take Advantage of ACEx2027 Early Bird Rates
